 Order
Memo of appearance filed by Mr. D.P. Dhal, learned Senior counsel for the Petitioners is taken on record.

2. Heard learned Senior Counsel for the Petitioners and learned counsel for the State.
3.

The Petitioners are accused in connection with S.A. Case No.23 of 2023, pending on the file of learned A.D.J.-cum-Special Judge, Nuapada, arising out of Jonk P.S. Case No.151 of 2023 for commission of the alleged offence under Sections 363/376(2)(n)/294/323/506/109/344/341/34 of IPC read with Section 6 & 17 of POCSO Act.

4. Being aggrieved by the rejection of their application for bail U/s. 439 Cr.P.C by the learned A.D.J.-cum-Special Judge, Nuapada by order dated 11.08.2023 in the aforementioned case, the present bail application has been filed.
5. It is submitted by the learned counsel that the Petitioners are in custody since 05.07.2023 and as charge sheet has already been filed on 11.08.2023, they may be released on bail.
6. It is stated that Petitioner Nos.1 and 2 are the parents and Petitioner No.3 is the brother of the Principal accused Dhananjaya Sahu.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the State opposes the prayer for bail.
8. Perused the 164 Cr.P.C. statement of the victim.
9. Considering the tenor thereof, period of custody and filing of charge sheet, this Court directs the Petitioners to be released on bail on such terms to be fixed by the learned Court in seisin.
10. Accordingly, the BLAPL stands disposed of.
11. Urgent certified copy of this order be granted as per rules.
